_comment: `working-directory` declarations that are KNOWN-OPEN rather than accepted. Unlike FOLIO_WORKDIRS, which says a directory is absent here on purpose and always will be, every entry below is a defect or an unknown somebody still owes an answer for — so this file may only SHRINK, and an entry that stops matching fails the run rather than being dropped quietly. Keyed by `<workflow>: <value>` rather than by line, so an unrelated step added above does not churn it. Each entry names the bean that owns it. 2026-09-22: BOTH `folio-assistant` entries removed. The owner ruled 'correct the path, no dispatch', so the stale #223 prefix became `cat-harness` in both workflows and the entries stopped matching -- which failed the run, exactly as this file's own rule says it should. publish.yml's separate UNREACHABILITY finding (its job needs content-pipeline, whose preflight reads content/schema/references.ts, absent here) is not erased by the path fix and is recorded on bean u9r9 instead of here, because it is not a working-directory defect.

why.lake-cache-refresh.yml: ${{ matrix.lake-: Undetermined, not missing — the value comes from `.github/lake-packages.json`, which that workflow's own header calls a SAMPLE roster whose "lake-root paths resolve only in a content repo". So it is folio-only in substance, but it cannot go in FOLIO_WORKDIRS: that table matches on a literal value, and reading this one means reading the matrix. Recorded here so it stays visible rather than being silently tolerated.
